name: Room Finishes from Zones
summary: Adds the floor finish, the ceiling with an optional cove and the wall finishes of the selected zones from favorites or materials; a re-run replaces them.

versions.changelog: Every dropdown can be searched: type in it to filter the list, the Down arrow opens it, Return picks the first match and Escape goes back to the previous choice.
The window opens smaller (760 x 700, at most 85 % of the screen), can be made as small as 640 x 520: the four finish panels are two by two, and the content scrolls when the window is short.

Cove: an optional Beam or Wall favorite along every straight room edge, standing on the ceiling's bottom, with the ceiling moved off the room edge by the offset typed in the window so that the cove sits in the gap.

Doors, windows and openings kept clear: each wall finish gets an opening, cutting only the finish, for every door, window and opening behind it, with a margin for frames (Archicad 29 and later). The summary lists them per zone and gives the wall finish area with the openings deducted.
Wall finishes: a wall along every part of a zone edge with a wall behind it, growing into the room from the floor finish's top to the ceiling's bottom (Archicad 28 and later).
First version: floor finishes and ceilings.
